jobs.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

We're seeking an experienced Warehouse Team Leader to join our operations team at our state-of-the-art facility in Gent Zeehaven. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll guide, inspire, and work alongside a dedicated team of warehouse professionals while ensuring operational excellence in our fast-paced international logistics environment.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Team Leadership: Coach and motivate warehouse staff to consistently achieve operational KPIs and quality standards

Operational Planning: Create efficient work schedules, allocate resources, and optimize workflow processes

Hands-On Management: Lead by example - work directly with your team using forklifts and warehouse equipment when needed

Performance Management: Monitor team performance, provide feedback, and implement improvement initiatives

Critical Decision Making: Make quick, effective decisions during peak periods and tight deadline situations

Safety & Compliance: Ensure all safety protocols and quality standards are maintained at all times

Reporting: Provide regular updates to warehouse supervisors and operational management

Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance efficiency and reduce operational costs

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

Essential Requirements:

3+ years of team leadership experience in warehouse, logistics, or distribution environments

Forklift certification (or commitment to obtain certification within 30 days)

Strong communication skills in Dutch and English (French is a plus)

Proven track record of meeting KPIs and managing operational deadlines

Physical stamina for hands-on warehouse work and extended periods on your feet

Flexible schedule - ability to work various shifts including occasional weekends

Problem-solving mindset with ability to make decisions under pressure

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related field or equal through experience

Experience with WMS (Warehouse Management Systems)

Knowledge of customs procedures and international shipping

Lean/Six Sigma certification or continuous improvement experience

Multilingual capabilities for our international client base

Just graduated and have recently obtained your bachelor's degree? Interested in a leadership role? Our client, Katoen Natie in Ghent, has a vacancy for a Supply Chain Trainee.

 

 

Grow into a leadership position with the Supply Chain Traineeship

 

 

As a Supply Chain Trainee, you will have the opportunity to advance to a leadership role within one of our logistics operations within a span of 2 years. Your logistics career will take off with an extensive on-the-job training program lasting approximately 2 years. The emphasis is on developing operational skills, leadership qualities, and specialization.

 

A diverse journey.

 

 

Throughout this exploratory experience, you will have the chance to become familiar with various operations and clients. This will enable you to discover the possibilities available to you within the company. There will be a total of 4 evaluation moments during the program. Depending on your competencies and interests, you may progress to a leadership position, such as a team leader overseeing a team/department and being responsible for guiding and coaching your team within a specific department.

 

 

 

• You have obtained a bachelor's degree in logistics, business or business management, trade, etc.

• Or you have an A2 diploma with relevant work experience, such as team leader, shift leader, supervisor, logistics employee, forklift driver, ambitious warehouse employee, etc.

• You speak fluent English and Dutch

• You are a true people manager and enjoy leading others.

• You can remain calm in stressful situations and are willing to make decisions.

• You have a hands-on mentality and are willing to actively get things done.

• You are willing to invest in yourself, you are driven and eager to learn.

• You are flexible in terms of working hours (shifts) and tasks.

Ready to kick-start your logistics career? On behalf of our client Katoen Natie, we're seeking motivated Order Pickers / Warehouse Employees for their dynamic operations in Gent Zeehaven. This is a temporary contract with excellent potential for permanent employment - your chance to prove yourself while learning from industry experts.

As an order picker, you'll be a crucial link in the international logistics chain, handling valuable materials and ensuring smooth operations for clients worldwide. This versatile role offers the perfect opportunity to develop your skills in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

• 

• YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Order Picking: Accurately collect goods from warehouse locations using picking lists and handheld scanners

Quality Control: Inspect items for damage and ensure correct quantities before processing

Packing & Preparation: Prepare orders for shipping, including proper packaging and labeling

Receiving: Unload deliveries, check incoming goods, and update inventory systems

Inventory Management: Organize stock locations and maintain warehouse cleanliness

Safety Compliance: Follow all safety protocols and maintain a secure working environment

Team Collaboration: Work effectively with colleagues across different shifts

Continuous Improvement: Suggest ways to optimize processes and increase efficiency

• Essential Requirements:
Basic logistics experience (warehouse, order picking, packing, production) OR strong willingness to learn

Enthusiastic attitude combined with a hands-on mentality - ready to roll up your sleeves!

Reliability and punctuality - your team depends on you

Eye for detail and quality - accuracy is crucial in our operations

Physical fitness - comfortable standing, walking, and lifting throughout your shift

Availability for 2-shift system (early and late shifts)

Basic Dutch or English communication skills

What Makes You Stand Out:

Experience with warehouse management systems (WMS) or scanning equipment

Forklift or reach truck certification (or willingness to obtain)

Previous experience in international logistics or port operations

Multilingual skills for our diverse, international workplace

Positive team player attitude with problem-solving mindset

Do you have experience as a forklift driver?As the driver of the forklift truck with long forks, you are responsible for storing goods and loading/unloading the trucks. In addition, you sometimes help with other tasks in the warehouse (order picking, receiving, stock counting, etc.). For this, you will use a scanner.You will start in the Katoen Natie warehouses in Ghent.

Profile

• You have experience with a forklift truck with long forks (2m40) or you have extensive experience with a forklift truck with short forks and you see yourself driving the long-fork truck as well.

• A forklift certificate is not a requirement, experience is more important. There will be a theoretical and practical test

• To communicate effectively with your colleagues, you speak and understand Dutch or English well.

• You can work in a two-shift system

• You are motivated and reliable, and you prize safety and quality.

• You are flexible when it comes to hours and tasks

• In addition, you know how to use a scanner and a computer

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you will be involved in the complete development of innovative machines and testing systems. From the initial concept to the final installation at the customer's site, you will play an active role throughout the entire project lifecycle. This is a varied position combining engineering, assembly, testing and international commissioning.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, your responsibilities include:

• Developing and improving new machines and technical solutions.
• Building, assembling and testing prototypes.
• Installing, commissioning and fine-tuning equipment at customer sites both nationally and internationally.
• Analysing technical issues and proposing improvements to products and processes.
• Preparing technical documentation, manuals and work instructions.
• Collaborating closely with colleagues from engineering, production and service departments.
• Providing technical support during demonstrations, trade fairs and commercial activities.

For this positFor this position as Project Engineer Machine Building, we are looking for an all-round engineer who enjoys combining theory with hands-on technical work. You like taking ownership of projects from start to finish and are willing to travel internationally on a regular basis.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you have:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electromechanics, Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, Machine Building or a related technical field.
• A strong interest in machine building, automation and product development.
• A hands-on mentality and practical approach to engineering.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Willingness to travel internationally for installations and commissioning projects.
• A good command of English.
• Knowledge of Dutch is mandatory.
• A valid Category B driving licence.

For a fast-growing manufacturing company, we are looking for a hands-on ERP Application Manager.
The group will implement a new ERP package (MS Dynamics F&O) and want to attract someone who will lead this project.
 

In this key role, the application manager will act as the bridge between the needs of their business departments and the ERP solution, ensuring seamless implementation across the organization.
 

This is a job on-site in Tournai with travel to their production site in France from time to time.
 

Functie
 
 

• Understand and analyze the current systems (own build applications) to identify opportunities for improvement. 

• Collaborate with departments (production, logistics, finance, etc.) to gather their needs and ensure they are reflected in the ERP system. 

• Lead the ERP implementation, introducing modules step by step while ensuring strong alignment across internal teams. 

• Direct the software partner and other external consultants. 

• Evaluate and optimize current processes to improve efficiency, standardization, and flexibility. 

• Identify custom needs and differentiate ERP functions from other tools (e.g., WMS, MES, BI). 

• You give support and training to the users. 

• Define user roles and access levels, as well as onboarding procedures for new employees. 
 

• At least 3 years of experience implementing ERP systems (SAP, D365, or equivalent). 

• A solid understanding of software environments (ERP, WMS, CMMS, MES, CRM, HR systems). 

• Experience in the food industry or knowledge of traceability systems (a plus). 

• Project management expertise: Familiarity with principles and methodologies to manage ERP rollout projects. 

• Strong problem-solving skills to handle technical challenges quickly and effectively. 

• Excellent communication skills to interact with stakeholders at all levels. 

• A detail-oriented mindset to ensure system accuracy and data integrity.  
 

• You’re independent, a great team player, and excel in building connections. 

• Dynamic, proactive and curious. 

• Fluency in English. Knowledge of French and Dutch is a plus.

This is a full-time role for an Inside Sales (ENG) who speaks English, based in Merchtem. 
 

You will be responsible for communicating with customers, handling orders, and coordinating with the warehouse team to ensure smooth and timely delivery of products.
 

Additionally, the Internal Sales Employee will prepare sales quotations, follow up on leads, and collaborate closely with the sales teams. The focus  for this position is the region of Eastern Europe and English-speaking markets.
 

Is this job, where you can use your communication skills and languages, for you? Apply now via this site!

 

• Ability to work independently as well as within a team. 

• You are fluent in English. 

• Proficiency in additional languages is considered an advantage. 

• Excellent communication and customer service skills.

What you'll do :
 
 

• Understand clients' business needs and translate them into clear, feasible end-to-end AI solutions 

• Act as a trusted point of contact for clients throughout the project, from scoping to delivery 

• Run discovery sessions and technical workshops with business and technical stakeholders 

• Design and build AI solutions combining LLMs, vector databases, APIs, orchestration layers and user interfaces 

• Develop agents and RAG pipelines connecting client data to LLMs for grounded, reliable answers 

• Perform prompt and context engineering to improve output quality and reduce hallucinations 

• Build, train and evaluate classical ML models (classification, regression, forecasting, clustering) when they are the best fit for the problem 

• Handle the data side: gathering, cleaning, validating data quality and feature engineering 

• Evaluate solutions rigorously, using ML metrics, generative AI metrics and production monitoring (quality, drift, costs) 

• Deploy solutions to the cloud with attention to security, reliability and cost efficiency, including versioning and reproducibility of models and data 

• Present and explain AI concepts, trade-offs and results to non-technical audiences 

• Support sales in qualifying opportunities, estimating effort and writing proposals 

• Contribute to demos, proofs of concept and internal knowledge sharing 

Who we're looking for :
 
 

• You hold a Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related field 

• You have 2 to 5 years of experience in AI/ML engineering or related fields 

• You're proficient in Python and software development best practices 

• You have strong machine learning fundamentals: supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model validation and the statistics behind them 

• You have hands-on experience with the Python data and ML stack: Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn and PyTorch (or TensorFlow) 

• You have a solid understanding of LLM fundamentals: Transformers, generation parameters, RAG and fine-tuning approaches 

• You have hands-on experience with tools such as the OpenAI API, Hugging Face, LangChain/LangGraph, FastAPI and Docker 

• You're comfortable working with data in SQL databases 

• You're a natural consultant: you listen, ask the right questions and see the business behind the technical problem 

• You're comfortable presenting to clients and explaining complex topics simply 

• You have strong problem-solving ability and a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset 

• You have a team spirit and enjoy collaborating across multiple roles 

• You're autonomous, curious, and quick to learn new tools 

• You can communicate fluently in English and French or Dutch

jobs.occupation: Dutch & French Speaking Banking Customer Support Officer – Relocation to Malta
jobs.description:
Working closely with the Wealth Support - Manager, you will be supporting our customers throughout their customer journey. You will be joining a fast-paced, innovative environment and a vibrant and dynamic team. We are driven by providing excellent customer service which in turn provides you with an excellent opportunity to grow and learn.Our shift hours are between 9 am and 8 pm in combination with a hybrid working model, this adds value to your personal planning and work life balance. The role also provides the opportunity to gain a professional certificate in Bank Mediation (Febelfin – Wet Willems).

The selected candidate should be willing to relocate to Malta.

•

• 

Providing customers with information about the Bank’s products and services

• 

Following up on customers’ instructions including payments, placement of trades, transfer of investment portfolios, and account opening and closure

• 

Supporting the Bank’s marketing strategy throughout various campaigns focusing on savings and wealth products

Required knowledge, skills and experience

• 

Native Dutch or French - Dutch/French-only speakers are also encouraged to apply. 

• 

Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English is a plus

• 

Previous experience in a customer service role will be considered an asset

Your Job as a Cross Contamination Compliance Engineer

Do you enjoy combining quality compliance with technical risk management in a pharmaceutical production environment? As a Cross Contamination Compliance Engineer, you will play a key role in maintaining and strengthening the cross contamination strategy at a leading API manufacturing site in Geel. You will work closely with operations and multiple departments to identify, assess, and mitigate contamination risks. Your expertise will help ensure sustainable compliance and support safe manufacturing processes. This is a visible role with a direct impact on quality, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Fortunately, we can count on you for:

 
• Maintaining and reviewing cross contamination risk assessments
 
• Ensuring contamination risks remain controlled during MoC activities
 
• Preparing, facilitating, and documenting cross contamination FMEAs
 
• Supporting operations during complex quality incidents and investigations
 
• Identifying improvement opportunities within contamination control processes
 
• Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across manufacturing and quality
 
• Contributing to the site's contamination control strategy and compliance goals

You communicate clearly with different stakeholders and know how to build strong working relationships. You approach challenges in a structured way and can balance quality requirements with operational realities. You enjoy coordinating activities and bringing people together around a common objective.

What do you bring?

 
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Technology, Chemistry, Bioengineering or equivalent experience
 
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a pharmaceutical or industrial manufacturing environment
 
• Knowledge of GMP, change management, FMEA, and risk assessment methodologies
 
• Understanding of cross contamination risks and contamination control principles; Annex 1 knowledge is an asset
 
• Fluent in English; Dutch is considered a strong asset

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated individual to join our accounting team. As an 
Accounts Payable Specialist, you will play a crucial role in the creation and execution of our Accounts Payable 2.0 processes, transitioning from manual invoice processing to automated workflows, with a focus on KPI reporting, efficiency enhancement, and transparency. The ideal candidate will have excellent analytical skills, advanced proficiency in Excel and SAP.
 

This role will address existing challenges, establish robust processes, and ensure the accurate and timely processing of all AP flows.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Test and implement new or updated vendor invoice management systems. 

• Develop and implement effective processes and KPIs to streamline and monitor manual tasks. 

• Implement critical checkpoints for automatically posted invoices to ensure accuracy and efficiency. 

• Collaborate with Logistics and Purchasing teams to identify opportunities for improvement and increase the number of automatically processed invoices. 

• Create and maintain full Procure-to-Pay (P2P) reporting using advanced Excel and SAP knowledge. 

• Provide guidance and training to the accounting team to bridge knowledge gaps and improve overall team efficiency. 

• Foster transparency in operational processes, vendor balances, and dispute resolutions.  

 

 

• Proven experience in accounts payable or a similar accounting role with a focus on process improvement. 

• Advanced proficiency in Excel and intermediate SAP knowledge. 

• Strong communication skills in English. 

• Analytical skills to design and implement checks for automation in the P2P process. 

• Ability to lead and collaborate with cross-functional and international teams. 

• Detail-oriented, with strong organizational and time management skills. 

• Ability to adapt to a dynamic work environment and drive positive change.

Historically recognized as the global benchmark for premium retail equipment and trolley manufacturing, 
Wanzl has successfully evolved into a 
total solutions provider optimizing customer experiences.
 

To support the ambitious course in Belgium and Luxembourg, Wanzl is looking for an entrepreunerial Business Development Manager.  This role is pivotal in driving the new era, turning premium product innovations and digital solutions into sustainable market share.
 

As Business Development Manager, you act as 'co-architect' of the business transformation in BeLux, supporting the General Manager. You combine traditional sales with high-level strategic business development to gain market share with new, digital, and automated solutions. You pioneer new growth areas while further expanding existing strategic partnerships.
 
 

• You further design and implement a sustainable go-to-market strategy to successfully position the renewed Wanzl portfolio in the market. 

• You take responsibility for major, existing key accounts in retail and proactively expand the C-level relationship network within complex Decision Making Units. 

• You actively identify market opportunities for product innovations (such as digital retail and automation solutions) and lead the acquisition process from A to Z, including complex price negotiations. 

• You implement structured and data-driven sales management (CRM, forecasting, and account planning) to achieve commercial performance and strict P&L and margin targets. 

• You work closely with the local sales and operational teams and the international headquarters to guarantee an optimal customer journey and efficient collaboration. 
 

• You hold a university degree and have 10 to 15 years of proven successful B2B sales and business development experience, preferably in retail or other relevant sector. 

• You are accustomed to operating in highly competitive markets and have experience managing complex key accounts. 

• You combine a strong commercial and entrepreneurial mindset with analytical skills and a P&L and margin focus, capable of translating data into concrete actions. 

• You have a proactive hands-on mentality and enjoy taking independent initiative to drive the business forward. 

• You communicate convincingly at various levels and are fluent in Dutch and French (required for the local market), as well as English (communications with HQ and other affiliates). Knowledge of German is a nice plus.

jobs.occupation: Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering Data Centres
jobs.description:
As a Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, you coordinate the entire engineering and design process. You monitor the technical scope, planning and engineering budget, ensuring that the different disciplines work together towards one integrated design.

• Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams within complex data centre projects

• Manage the technical scope, engineering budget and associated contract documentation

• Prepare and monitor the engineering schedule and allocate tasks within the team

• Coordinate the different technical disciplines and ensure alignment between their designs

• Coordinate collaboration between Belgian and international engineering teams

• Work closely with external consultants, contractors and other technical partners

• Review technical design decisions and challenge or adjust them where necessary

• Manage design changes and assess their impact on the overall project

• Translate complex client requirements into technically feasible solutions

• Present and discuss technical concepts with clients and project teams

• Remain involved during the execution phase and act as a technical point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders

For the position of Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, we are looking for someone who combines strong technical knowledge with excellent coordination skills. Experience within data centres is an advantage, but experience with industrial buildings or other technically complex building projects can also be a strong match.

• You hold a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical discipline

• You have at least 5 years of experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects

• You have experience leading and coordinating engineers and other technical stakeholders

• You are familiar with complex technical building installations and multidisciplinary engineering

• Experience with data centres, industrial buildings or other complex built environments is a strong advantage

• You are familiar with digital engineering processes, 3D design and BIM environments

• You have a good understanding of relevant standards, regulations and working methods within engineering and construction

• You communicate effectively with engineers, consultants, contractors and clients

• English knowledge is a must, Dutch and French are a plus

Relevant experience is essential for this position. We are specifically looking for candidates who have previously worked in a similar role, coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects within data centres, industrial buildings or other technically complex environments.

If you do not have relevant experience in a comparable position or project environment, we kindly ask you not to apply for this vacancy.
